answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the shale queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The delta index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 950 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the quill. A 415 account operation therefore ties up 18 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
